description: Automated Go module updates. Mirrors .github/dependabot.yml: weekly, patch-only for the Kubernetes/OpenShift ecosystem, updates grouped to reduce PR noise. The k8s.io staging modules are grouped separately because they must share one version; hack/verify-k8s-deps.sh enforces that.

packageRules.description: Also update indirect dependencies, so the k8s staging set can move as a whole.
The pinned ginkgo fork is required for openshift-tests-extension compatibility; bump it manually.
Kubernetes/OpenShift ecosystem: patch updates only, minor and major versions have breaking API changes.

k8s.io staging libraries are released in lockstep from kubernetes/kubernetes and must share one version, so keep them in a dedicated PR. klog, utils, kube-openapi and gengo version independently and are excluded. Renovate cannot enforce equal versions (renovatebot/renovate#12310), so hack/verify-k8s-deps.sh checks the result.
Group independently versioned k8s tooling and the remaining Kubernetes/OpenShift patch updates into one PR.
Group all remaining minor and patch updates into one PR. A list of only negative patterns matches everything else, so no leading "*" is needed (and Renovate rejects it).
